title: Validity of the losses generated in an episode
statement: Fix a number of experts $N \ge 1$ and a number of rounds $T$, and consider any episode for $N$ experts over $T$ rounds — that is, a learner policy, an adaptive adversary, and a loss sequence $\ell$ of length $T$ that equals the sequence generated by running that learner against that adversary. Then $\ell$ is a valid loss sequence: for every round $t < T$ and every expert $i$, the generated loss satisfies $0 \le \ell_t(i) \le 1$.
hypotheses_covered: an episode: learner policy, adaptive adversary, and loss sequence of length T
the loss sequence equals the one generated by running the learner against the adversary
replaced:
For any $\texttt{Episode}\ N\ T$, the stored loss sequence $\mathrm{episode.losses}$
is valid, i.e., every loss coordinate lies in $[0, 1]$.
